recommendation: Keep the source fix. It implements the accepted core examples without trying to define a complete lab status vocabulary in core; future domain-specific Task.businessStatus vocabularies should be handled in implementation guides or separate terminology work.
issue_request: FHIR-39324 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification. It requested an example value set for Task.businessStatus for lab workflows, with simple examples such as partially dispensed and billing pending, and binding-description guidance that implementation guides are the appropriate place to define complete sets for the use case at hand.
initial_application: March 2025 Task commits 768642cfce, 5f07cdbfb1, and fd61e521be added the TaskBusinessStatus value set and code system, populated initial example concepts, and wired Task.businessStatus to ValueSet/task-business-status. That application left out the two examples named in FHIR-39324 and did not add the requested implementation-guide guidance to the binding description.
additional_context: FHIR-49109 is the same Task example-binding change family and explains the broader R6 work to add Task example binding descriptions and value sets. FHIR-45320 covers the missing TaskBusinessStatus value-set concern and is already audited on the combined branch. OO Confluence minutes show FHIR-39324 originated in lab workflow discussion about Task.businessStatus, with complete lab-specific scope still unresolved before the Jira final resolution.
reconciliation: Changed active Task source only: source/task/codesystem-task-business-status.xml now includes partially-dispensed and billing-pending example concepts, and source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml now says implementation guides define complete use-case-specific sets for the Task.businessStatus binding. Generated diagram artifacts were left unchanged for normal build regeneration.
